Download atmospheric composition data

Source: R/source-geos.R
download_geos.Rd

The download_geos() function accesses and downloads various atmospheric composition collections from NASA's Global Earth Observing System (GEOS) compositional forecast model.

Usage

download_geos(
  collection = c("aqc_tavg_1hr_g1440x721_v1", "chm_tavg_1hr_g1440x721_v1",
    "met_tavg_1hr_g1440x721_x1", "xgc_tavg_1hr_g1440x721_x1",
    "chm_inst_1hr_g1440x721_p23", "met_inst_1hr_g1440x721_p23"),
  nasa_earth_data_token = NULL,
  date = c("2018-01-01", "2018-01-01"),
  hours = 0:23,
  directory_to_save = NULL,
  acknowledgement = FALSE,
  download = TRUE,
  remove_command = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  hash = FALSE,
  max_tries = 20,
  rate_limit = 2
)

Arguments

collection

character(1). GEOS-CF data collection file name.

nasa_earth_data_token

character(1) or NULL. NASA EarthData authentication token.

date

character(1 or 2). A single date or inclusive range endpoints in "YYYY-MM-DD" format, in either order.

hours

integer(1 to 24). Hours of day to download for each date, in UTC. Supply values from 0 through 23. Default is 0:23, which selects all hours. The collection determines the minute within each selected hour.

directory_to_save

character(1). Directory to save data.

acknowledgement

logical(1). Must be TRUE to proceed

download

logical(1). DEPRECATED. Downloads happen automatically.

remove_command

logical(1). Deprecated, ignored.

show_progress

logical(1). Show download progress (default TRUE)

hash

logical(1). Return hash of downloaded files (default FALSE)

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum retry attempts (default 20)

rate_limit

numeric(1). Minimum seconds between requests (default 2)

Value

With download = FALSE, an invisible preview list containing urls, destfiles, and n_files. With download = TRUE and hash = FALSE, an invisible summary from download_run_method() containing success, failed, skipped, failed_urls, and failed_files. The two failure vectors are character(0) when no downloads failed, including when every file was skipped. With download = TRUE and hash = TRUE, a visible character scalar containing the combined MD5 hash of the output directory.

Details

Hour selection uses the timestamps of the requested collection. Hourly time-averaged collections (_tavg_1hr_) use timestamps at 30 minutes past the hour, while hourly instantaneous collections (_inst_1hr_) use timestamps on the hour. For example, hours = c(0, 6) selects 00:30 and 06:30 UTC for time-averaged collections, or 00:00 and 06:00 UTC for instantaneous collections. The same hour selection applies to every date in the requested range.

Note

Due to NASA data access policies, downloads require a valid NASA Earthdata token for authentication. Use setup_nasa_token() for setup.

References

Keller CA, Knowland KE, Duncan BN, Liu J, Anderson DC, Das S, Lucchesi RA, Lundgren EW, Nicely JM, Nielsen E, Ott LE, Saunders E, Strode SA, Wales PA, Jacob DJ, Pawson S (2021). “Description of the NASA GEOS Composition Forecast Modeling System GEOS‐CF v1.0.” Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems, 13(4), e2020MS002413. ISSN 1942-2466, 1942-2466. doi:10.1029/2020MS002413 .

Author

Mitchell Manware, Insang Song

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_geos(
  collection = "aqc_tavg_1hr_g1440x721_v1",
  date = "2024-01-01",
  hours = c(0, 6, 12, 18),
  directory_to_save = tempdir(),
  acknowledgement = TRUE
)
} # }
